posts.title: Three poems in translation
posts.description: Another Chicago Magazine published three poems by Axel Pinpin in my translation: "How to Kill Boredom Inside a Cell," "Reality Show: Bus No. 914," and "In and Out."Read them here.

posts.title: I Am Not My Poetry
posts.description: "I Am Not My Poetry," my translation of "Ang Tula Ko Ay Hindi Ako" by Axel Pinpin, appeared on Asymptote Blog last month. This translation was made back in 2010.Read it here.

posts.title: Listening inside Plato's cave
posts.description: Walang Mabanaag (Unable to Decipher) by Mesándel Virtusio Arguelles (University of the Philippines Press, 2026) “Never mistranslate. Translation is sacred,” says a character in Bong Joon Ho’s film Okja (2017).
